statement: Every production consensus opening distinguishes a never-opened lifecycle allocation from an established native history. Initial native bootstrap and the exact-incarnation establishment witness commit atomically before participation or port publication; intact records restore, while an established or unknown history with an absent native record refuses before native entry. Host prior-existence and identity-record participation fences remain independent requirements. No service-specific history oracle or second lifecycle store is added.

constraints.statement: The lifecycle owner writes the local history fact in its existing row; the runtime/store own bootstrap transaction ordering and the participation gate owns opening refusal. No new durable store or fallback.
Crash before establishment permits a genuine never-opened retry; crash after its durable commit never permits fresh genesis after native row loss. NULL legacy history is unknown, never a fresh grant.
No election, lease, caller, transport, recovery or seed deadline changes. The operator 10x rule applies only to observed test execution cost.
Independent review and all required gates are required before landing. WIP branch preservation is not approval.
